meta.name: Negative control — a lane offset the site cannot satisfy must fail, not relocate
meta.description: The companion to `caps-map.template.json`. It requires a corridor exactly one lane wide and then authors a prop row in the lane beside it, which is a contradiction. Before, `framePosePoint` resolved the missing lane to the *reference* lane and pushed a note: the cones materialised in the ego's own lane, `manifest.feasible` stayed true, and the cell ran and reported a metric for a scene nobody described. Now the same document fails with `lane_offset_unavailable`, naming the requested k and the offsets the site actually has. This is the loud half of the fix and it is exercised through the prop path deliberately, because that path bypasses the matcher entirely.

declarations.description: Metres the neighbour starts ahead of the ego in the adjacent lane. Short leads make the incursion late and unavoidable.
Lateral closing rate of the incursion. Below ~0.6 m/s it reads as a drift, above ~1.4 m/s as a swerve.
